name: M5HAL
description: Hardware Abstraction Layer(HAL) for M5 Products

build.comment: M5HAL requires C++17. These flags apply to M5HAL's OWN sources only (PlatformIO scopes library.json build to a per-library environment; they do NOT reach the consumer's translation unit — a consumer that includes <M5HAL_v2.hpp> must still set -std=gnu++17 itself, and gets a clear #error from the header if it forgets). Their job is to keep a downstream build that forgot -std from ALSO drowning in errors out of M5HAL's own .cpp files. espressif32@6.x / Arduino core 2.x defaults to gnu++11.
